summary_en: 120,000 shares (1.55% of S/O ex-treasury) at ¥152.4M upper limit. ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST, priced at the 2026-08-07 close of ¥1,270/share. Principal shareholder Hitoshi Minauchi confirmed intent to participate; major shareholder status may shift.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-07, KNC Laboratories' board resolved to acquire up to 120,000 treasury shares (1.55% of the 7,749,520 shares outstanding excluding treasury) at an upper limit of ¥152.4 million. Execution is via a single ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trade on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST, priced at the prior day's closing price of ¥1,270 per share. The order is valid only during the specified trading window; partial or no execution is possible depending on market conditions. The company stated the rationale as improving capital efficiency and executing flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Notably, principal shareholder Hitoshi Minauchi confirmed intent to participate in the sale; depending on the volume he sells, the major shareholder composition may shift.
